name: plan-furnish-windows
description: PLAN-FURNISH Phase 3 (window-bound fixtures in the 2D plan): arming curtains in the plan editor no longer toasts-and-refuses — the ghost SNAPS to the nearest window on the edited level (position + facing + window-sized props via the same windowSnap.ts pair the 3D commit uses) and a click commits it there; the placed item's position sits exactly ON a window's wall segment (store assert against the plan's own window openings) with windowFixtureProps sizing (width/height/sillY); a plan whose edited level has NO windows toasts 'No window to place on' and disarms on arming; the placed curtain round-trips into the 3D scene on its window.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: hover-near-a-window
steps.eval: (function(){ const svg = document.querySelector('.plan-screen svg.plan-paper'); const fp = window.__store.getState().floorPlan; const win = fp.openings.find(o => o.kind === 'window'); if (!win) throw new Error('no window opening'); const el = svg.querySelector('[data-opening="' + win.id + '"]'); if (!el) throw new Error('window opening element not rendered'); const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const sr = svg.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = r.left + r.width / 2, cy = r.top + r.height / 2; const dx = (sr.left + sr.width / 2) - cx, dy = (sr.top + sr.height / 2) - cy; const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1; window.__pt = { x: cx + (dx / len) * 30, y: cy + (dy / len) * 30 }; window.__winRect = { x: cx, y: cy }; window.__winId = win.id; svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: window.__pt.x, clientY: window.__pt.y, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse' })); })()

steps.name: ghost-snapped-and-valid
steps.failMessage: The curtain ghost should render VALID (green), snapped onto the hovered window

steps.name: assert-ghost-on-window
steps.eval: (function(){ const g = document.querySelector('[data-plan-ghost="curtains"] polygon'); if (!g) throw new Error('ghost polygon missing'); const r = g.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = r.left + r.width / 2, cy = r.top + r.height / 2; const d = Math.hypot(cx - window.__winRect.x, cy - window.__winRect.y); if (d > 30) throw new Error('ghost centre is ' + d.toFixed(1) + 'px from the window centre — not snapped'); console.log('ghost snapped onto the window, ' + d.toFixed(1) + 'px from its centre'); })()

steps.name: click-to-commit
steps.eval: (function(){ const svg = document.querySelector('.plan-screen svg.plan-paper'); const opts = { clientX: window.__pt.x, clientY: window.__pt.y, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 0, buttons: 1 }; svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', opts)); svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', opts)); })()

steps.name: curtain-committed

waitFor.store: state.items.length === window.__base + 1 && state.activeDefId === null && state.pendingEdit && state.pendingEdit.kind === 'placement'

steps.failMessage: Clicking with a window-bound def armed should place it (snapped) and resolve to the normal plan placement confirm

steps.name: assert-position-on-window-segment-and-props
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); const item = st.items[st.items.length - 1]; if (item.defId !== 'curtains') throw new Error('last item is not the curtains: ' + item.defId); const fp = st.floorPlan; const byId = Object.fromEntries(fp.walls.map(w => [w.id, w])); const centres = fp.openings.filter(o => o.kind === 'window' && byId[o.wallId]).map(o => { const w = byId[o.wallId]; const dx = w.end[0] - w.start[0], dz = w.end[1] - w.start[1]; const len = Math.hypot(dx, dz); const t = o.offset + o.width / 2; return { id: o.id, x: w.start[0] + (dx / len) * t, z: w.start[1] + (dz / len) * t, width: o.width, sill: o.sill }; }); const best = centres.reduce((a, c) => { const d = Math.hypot(item.position[0] - c.x, item.position[1] - c.z); return !a || d < a.d ? { ...c, d } : a; }, null); if (!best || best.d > 0.001) throw new Error('placed curtain is ' + (best ? best.d.toFixed(3) : '?') + 'm from the nearest window centre — not snapped onto a window wall segment'); const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v)); const expWidth = clamp(best.width + 0.36, 1.0, 3.4); const expHeight = clamp(fp.ceilingHeight - 0.05, 1.8, 3.2); if (Math.abs(item.props.width - expWidth) > 1e-6) throw new Error('curtain width ' + item.props.width + ' != windowFixtureProps width ' + expWidth); if (Math.abs(item.props.height - expHeight) > 1e-6) throw new Error('curtain height ' + item.props.height + ' != windowFixtureProps height ' + expHeight); if (Math.abs(item.props.sillY - best.sill) > 1e-6) throw new Error('curtain sillY ' + item.props.sillY + ' != window sill ' + best.sill); console.log('curtain snapped to window ' + best.id + ' (d=' + best.d.toFixed(4) + 'm) with window-sized props'); })()

steps.name: strip-windows-from-plan
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); window.__fp = st.floorPlan; st.setFloorPlan({ ...st.floorPlan, openings: st.floorPlan.openings.filter(o => o.kind !== 'window') }); })()

steps.name: no-window-toast-and-disarm

waitFor.store: state.activeDefId === null && state.notifications.some(n => n.title === 'No window to place on')

steps.failMessage: Arming curtains on a level with no windows should toast 'No window to place on' (the 3D copy) and disarm
